info.title: VoidDNS management API
info.description: Configuration-backed single-server management with an embedded public UI and authenticated API on one HTTP listener. DNS response caches and active filtering lookups remain RAM-only. Imported snapshots persist in a separate SQLite database; SQLite also stores seven days of client request telemetry. No peer synchronization. All API endpoints require X-API-Key. Application errors are JSON; malformed HTTP framing and parser-level limits may produce plaintext errors from the HTTP library. API and UI settings, including the shared HTTP listener, require restart; live changes are rejected before saving or publication. Mutations require quoted If-Match and persistent mutations complete asynchronously. Client names persist synchronously in SQLite; incoming telemetry does not advance the global revision.

get.summary: Browse a published RAM snapshot or a retained saved snapshot
get.description: Imported names are read-only. Active and saved contents can differ after activation failure. Defaults to active for enabled sources and saved for disabled sources. Exact domain and prefix filters are mutually exclusive. Cursors bind to source, snapshot version, and filters; a changed snapshot returns 409. Never fetches the source.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Exact normalized ASCII name, case-insensitive with an optional trailing dot.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Case-insensitive ASCII name prefix, not suffix or wildcard matching.

400.description: Invalid name, prefix, limit, cursor, or conflicting filters.

401.description: Missing, duplicate, or invalid API key.

404.description: SourceNotFound or SnapshotUnavailable. An unavailable snapshot is distinct from a successfully imported empty list.

409.description: StaleCursor: snapshot changed. Reload contents explicitly.

503.description: Snapshot reader unavailable or busy.

post.summary: Batch current active list memberships for visible domain names
post.description: Read-only authenticated lookup, without If-Match or revision changes. Normalizes and deduplicates at most 100 input names. Returns only contributing active or degraded sources. These are memberships now, not historical blocking attribution.

DnsTcp.description: Incoming DNS TCP limits. Positive u32 values; live changes apply to new connections without restarting the listener.

min_positive_ttl_seconds.description: Minimum internal retention in seconds for cacheable positive upstream responses; 0 respects the original packet lifetime. Reuse lasts until the greater of the original packet lifetime and this minimum, which can serve stale destinations. Zero-TTL packets remain noncacheable, and negative NXDOMAIN/NODATA responses (including CNAME plus SOA) are unchanged. Client TTLs age from their original values and floor at zero; this setting never extends them. Changing this value clears the response cache.

ApiSettings.description: Required non-null API configuration. Enabled defaults to true. The API and embedded UI share api.listen (default 127.0.0.1:8080). Changes require restart and are rejected by live replacement or reload before saving or publication.

UiSettings.description: Required non-null embedded UI configuration. Enabled defaults to true and requires api.enabled to be true. UI assets are public; API endpoints always require authentication. Changes require restart and are rejected by live replacement or reload before saving or publication.

Source.description: Editable blocklist source definition. Runtime status is response-only and is rejected in input.

api_managed.description: Persistent provenance marker enforced by the server. New/content-changed sources become managed; a client cannot clear the marker on an existing managed source.

SourceHealth.description: Runtime import health, never persisted into configuration JSON. Error names contain no source location.

state.description: active: fetch succeeded; degraded: fetch failed and a compatible snapshot is serving; unavailable: enabled without a compatible snapshot; disabled: not serving imported names.

last_error.description: Safe error name from the latest failed import, without URLs or file paths.

last_success_at_ms.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the snapshot's last successful import, or null if none.

domain_count.description: Domain membership count for this source's runtime snapshot.

SourceView.description: Response-only blocklist source definition and current runtime health. Use Source, without status, for writes.

MembershipSource.description: An active or degraded source currently containing a requested exact name.

MembershipMatches.description: Current memberships only. Generation is process-local and must not be used as historical attribution.

version.description: Opaque content/publication version, not a source-definition fingerprint.

domain_count.description: Total snapshot membership count, independent of filters.

active.description: True only when this content is demonstrably the snapshot currently used by DNS.

Config.description: Only schema_version 2 is supported. Non-null api and ui objects are required; enabled defaults to true in each. API/UI true/true serves the public embedded UI and authenticated API; true/false serves API only with frontend routes returning 404; false/false is DNS-only with no HTTP listener; false/true is invalid. API/UI settings and the shared HTTP listener require restart; live changes are rejected before saving or publication.

saved_matches_active.description: Last known agreement from this process; null while an operation is running. External file edits are not watched.

matching_sources.description: Sources currently containing the name, regardless of policy overrides.

api_managed.description: Persistent provenance marker enforced by the server. New/content-changed sources become managed; a client cannot clear the marker on an existing managed source.
